name: 72002 · Alexander, AR
findings: ZIP 72002 (Alexander) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72002 (Alexander) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 72002 (Alexander) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 31% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
